recent.text: The Saints activated RB Travis Etienne Jr. from Injured Reserve, signed T Easton Kilty to the active roster, elevated Charlie Smyth to the active roster from the practice squad for Sunday’s game and placed Christen Miller on Injured Reserve.
recent.author: Katherine Terrell

recent.text: The Saints officially activated RB Travis Etienne from injured reserve. They placed rookie DT Christen Miller on IR. They also signed OL Easton Kilty and elevated K Charlie Smyth from the practice squad.
recent.author: Mike Triplett
recent.quoted_text: #Saints RB Travis Etienne Jr. is expected to be activated from Injured Reserve, putting him in line to play Sunday against the #Panthers. Etienne missed five games with a hamstring injury. First reported by @TomPelissero https://t.co/KDf3rfwUlp
